subject.title: [Bug]: Subagent completion silently lost — no retry, no notification, no auto-restart on timeout

question: Should this issue stay as the umbrella for subagent completion loss, or should maintainers consolidate the remaining durable-delivery work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67777 and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 only as a narrow candidate fix?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans retry policy, user-visible failure notification, restart/orphan recovery, duplicate-prevention, and task-ledger semantics, so automation should not choose the product boundary or close the open linked PR on its own.

options.title: Consolidate under durable-delivery plan
options.body: Keep this issue open or explicitly link it while making https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67777 the canonical design thread for durable spool/recovery semantics.

options.title: Review the linked narrow PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90561 as a limited visibility/retry improvement and require live multi-agent proof before it can close this issue.

options.title: Split remaining cases
options.body: Close only after maintainers split timeout, delivery, and artifact-verification leftovers into narrower canonical issues and preserve the field reports by linking them.

recommendation.title: Consolidate under durable-delivery plan
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open or explicitly link it while making https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/67777 the canonical design thread for durable spool/recovery semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent subagent completion handoff work and the related planning comments make this the best available routing candidate for the policy decision.
